This conservative rule can still require review for preprints or version ambiguity.

column1: is an internal research collaboration platform for managing reference PDFs through both a command-line interface (CLI) and a web interface. Users can upload local reference collections to the cloud without manually preparing or maintaining the original PDF metadata. The platform extracts identifiers such as DOIs, while its automated processing pipeline handles metadata cross-checking, file validation, normalization, and ingestion. Authorized team members can later locate literature with a single command or a web search and retrieve selected files through high-concurrency downloads, streamlining document archiving, sharing, and collaborative use.
column2: 是内部科研协作平台，通过命令行（CLI）和网页管理参考文献 PDF。用户可以直接上传本地文献集，无需手动维护原始 PDF 元数据。平台可提取 DOI 等标识，并自动完成元数据交叉核对、文件校验、标准化和入库。授权成员随后可以通过命令或网页搜索快速查找文献，并以高并发方式下载所选文件，方便存档、共享与协作。
column3: 是內部研究協作平台，透過命令列（CLI）和網頁管理參考文獻 PDF。使用者可直接上傳本機文獻集，不必手動維護原始 PDF 中繼資料。平台可擷取 DOI 等識別碼，自動進行中繼資料交叉核對、檔案驗證、標準化與入庫。經授權的成員隨後可透過命令或網頁搜尋快速尋找文獻，以高並行方式下載所選檔案，便於封存、分享與協作。
